title: 11.9 Regex Line Count
prompt: 11.9 Write a program that reads through mbox-short.txt and counts how many lines match the regular expression ^From using re.search(). Hard-code that pattern in your program (do not prompt for it). When you run the program, the output should be: mbox-short.txt had 27 lines that matched ^From .

student.py.starter:
import re

string = "^From "
handle = open("mbox-short.txt")
count = 0
for line in handle:
    if re.search(string) : count = count + 1
print("mbox-short.txt had ", count, "lines that matched", string)
student.py.solution:
import re

string = "^From "
handle = open("mbox-short.txt")
count = 0
for line in handle:
    line = line.rstrip()
    if re.search(string, line):
        count = count + 1
print("mbox-short.txt had", count, "lines that matched", string)
